prompt:
Handheld from inside the crowd, jostled and bumped the whole time, the same framing held. It stays dark from start to end: only the one spotlight on the man stays on, the floodlights stay off. The black silhouettes of heads and arms in the foreground sway and bob and rise, crossing the pool of light. The man on stage keeps his arms up and rocks his shoulders, slow and heavy. Haze drifts through the single beam. Sound: a crowd chanting and stamping in the dark, rising, no voices picked out, no music.
Thanks.
